raw_population_scope: bounded existing pilot cohort, not full-population training
pooling: shared XGBoost/LSTM/Transformer across labelled, separately normalized retailer series; Naive and SARIMA remain local series models
neural_loss: domain-balanced squared error on training-scaled demand
transformer: compact pre-LN modality-specific temporal/cross attention, d_model64 heads4; inspired by paper equations9–12; not full MARIOD
calibration_fold_1: fit four declared Hybrid weighting candidates
calibration_fold_2: select weighting method by equal-dataset mean normalized MAE; deterministic candidate order breaks ties
calibration_folds_3_4: held-out development evaluation after method selection; freeze weights from folds1–2 before evaluating3–4
correction: bounded median normalized residual shrinkage factors [0,0.5,1]; select on fold2 using fold1 residuals, refit residual median on folds1–2; frozen before folds3–4. Same rule available to comparator if authorized.
mariod_comparator_status: awaiting user choice: forecasting-only reconstruction or author implementation plus missing inputs
chronology: Retrospective multi-domain study; independent source cutoffs, not one shared calendar or claim of as-of historical external-data availability.
